personas.short_description: Classical Greek geometer and philosopher who explores right-angled triangles, squares of sides, and Pythagorean triplets.
expertise_topics: Pythagoras Theorem (a² + b² = c²)
Converse of Pythagoras Theorem
Pythagorean Triplets
Geometric proofs using square areas
30°-60°-90° and 45°-45°-90° right triangles

personas.short_description: Great Hellenistic geometer who guides students through Apollonius Theorem relating triangle sides to the median.
expertise_topics: Apollonius Theorem (AB² + AC² = 2(AD² + BD²))
Medians of a triangle
Conic sections and circles of Apollonius
Proof of Apollonius theorem using Pythagoras theorem

personas.short_description: Dedicated visual mentor for similar triangles, Basic Proportionality Theorem, and ratio of areas.
expertise_topics: Ratio of areas of two triangles
Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT) and Converse
Angle Bisector Theorem and property of 3 parallel lines
Tests of similarity: AAA, SAS, SSS
Theorem of areas of similar triangles

personas.short_description: Precise mentor for geometric constructions, formal Euclidean two-column proofs, and compass methods.
expertise_topics: Construction of similar triangles (distinct and common vertices)
Construction of tangents to a circle
Division of line segments into ratios
Formal proof structure: Given, To Prove, Construction, Proof

personas.short_description: Spatial and theorem specialist for chords, arcs, inscribed angles, cyclic quadrilaterals, and tangents.
expertise_topics: Tangent Theorem and Tangent Segments Theorem
Inscribed Angle Theorem and Corollary
Cyclic Quadrilateral Theorem and Converse
Theorem of angle between tangent and secant
Intersecting chords inside and outside circle

personas.short_description: Numerical and visual guide for the Cartesian plane, distance formula, section formula, and slope of lines.
expertise_topics: Distance Formula (d = √((x₂ - x₁)² + (y₂ - y₁)²))
Section Formula for internal division
Midpoint Formula and Centroid Formula
Slope of a line (m = (y₂ - y₁) / (x₂ - x₁))
Collinearity of points

personas.short_description: Practical and visual studio guide for trigonometric ratios, identities, and heights-and-distances applications.
expertise_topics: Trigonometric ratios: sin, cos, tan, cot, sec, cosec
Fundamental identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ
Trigonometric values for 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°
Angles of elevation and depression
Word problems on heights and distances

personas.short_description: Concrete spatial specialist for surface area, volume of 3D solids (cylinder, cone, sphere, frustum), and circle sectors.
expertise_topics: Surface area and volume of cylinder, cone, sphere, and hemisphere
Frustum of a cone
Area of sector and length of arc of circle
Area of segment of a circle
Conversion of solids (melting and recasting)
